# Capsule CRM | Core Use Cases

| Use case | Description |
| --- | --- |
| Small business contacts management | The “list or interactive entry - customer formation and business opportunities - push phase” triggers the next step - management of the flash drive” as the main link to verify whether small business contact management really reduces manual maintenance. It is recommended that data integrity rates, first response times, late follow-up, stopovers, AI recommendation acceptance rates and cost per active user be recorded. |
| Simple B2B pipe | Using “list or interactive entry - formation of customers and business - push phase” as the main link to trigger the next step - manage the double drive, the simple B2B pipeline is actually less manual. It is recommended that data integrity rates, first response times, late follow-up, stopovers, AI recommendation acceptance rates and cost per active user be recorded. |
| Project delivery after client transaction | Using “lists or interactive entry - formation of a customer and business - push phase” as the main link to trigger the next step - manage the double disk, to verify whether the delivery of the project by the customer actually reduces manual maintenance. It is recommended that data integrity rates, first response times, late follow-up, stopovers, AI recommendation acceptance rates and cost per active user be recorded. |
| Consultants and institutional client maintenance | Using “lists or interactive entry - customer formation and business opportunities - advance phase” as the main link to trigger the next step - managing the double disk, to verify whether consultancy and institutional customer maintenance actually reduce manual maintenance. It is recommended that data integrity rates, first response times, late follow-up, stopovers, AI recommendation acceptance rates and cost per active user be recorded. |
